name: Okteto
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Denver, CO, USA; Madrid, Community of Madrid, Spain; Buenos Aires, CABA, Argentina; Remote
long_description:
Okteto gives every developer, coding agent and pull request an on-demand application environment on your own Kubernetes infrastructure.

Define your environment once, reusing your existing Helm, Compose or Kubernetes manifests, and use the same versioned definition across development, CI, previews and AI coding agents. Less configuration drift, less duplicated setup, and centrally managed access to clusters, registries and cloud resources.

Run coding agents on your cluster, batteries included. Launch them with Okteto's built-in orchestrator or bring your own, including agents running locally like Claude Code or Cursor, while Okteto manages the environments they build, deploy and test against. The agent stays small; the application runs in a real environment.

Your code meets Kubernetes earlier in the cycle. Every change gets automated tests against running services and a live preview URL that developers, QA and product managers can open without any local setup.

Built for platform teams that run environments at scale: Divert deploys only the services that change against a shared base, while automatic sleep, garbage collection, quotas and Smart Builds keep resource usage under control.

Self-hosted on your Kubernetes, including air-gapped clusters. SOC 2 Type 2 compliant.
